source.author: cic
source.text: fuerat enim auditor Anaxagorae, quem ferunt nuntiata morte filii dixisse: sciebam me genuisse mortalem.
source.text_original: fuerat enim auditor Anaxagorae, quem ferunt nuntiata morte filii dixisse: sciebam me genuisse mortalem.
source.text_english: For he had been a listener to Anaxagoras, who, they say, when the death of his son was announced, said: I knew that I had begotten a mortal.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: Did I know that I had given birth to a mortal?
